topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I suppose everyone has that moment when the rug gets pulled out from under them, but when I heard about Alex moving, it felt like the start of a new chapter. I've always envied Alex's bravery, the way they seize opportunities without hesitation. And now, as much as the thought of saying goodbye nips at my heart, there's this underlying thrill. It's like the world is opening up, not just for Alex, but in a strange way, for me too. Maybe this is the push I needed to think about what I truly want, to imagine my own adventures. It's a bit of a squeeze, yes, but also a spark.
